rubric.description: Assess only substantive inspection of the rendered transaction relationships before presentation. Candidate observations must inspect how equipment identity, volunteer identity, due time and the corresponding checkout or return action are grouped in the rendered interface. Runtime DOM markup, a meaningful accessibility representation, or rendered relationship text with relevant geometry can suffice. A document header, element counts, source inspection alone, or an unsupported review claim does not establish this inspection. Different valid representations and layouts are allowed; do not require a specific selector or a duplicate structural dump for every state. A required inspection omitted from a complete relevant record fails. Unavailable relevant observations leave this criterion uncertain. This calibration does not establish image inspection, responsive behavior, every transaction flow, focus coverage, or the complete design criterion.

examples.request: Prepare an equipment-checkout screen for Eastbank volunteers. Keep the equipment-first and volunteer-first options open for comparison.
